values.meaning: Bonus Magic Damage on basic attacks and basic abilities

mechanics.claim: Passive bonus damage from basic attacks can be blocked.
mechanics.quote: Passive bonus damage from basic attacks can be {{tip|blocked}}.

mechanics.claim: The active is a dash and Qiyana can cast any of her abilities during it, so it does not lock out other abilities.
mechanics.quote: ''Qiyana'' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

mechanics.claim: The active itself deals no damage; it only swaps the held Element (Brush/River/Terrain), which changes the passive's damage type/effects granted, not a direct damage instance.
mechanics.quote: dashes up to 300 units towards the target location to gather the {{as|Element|buzzword}}

mechanics.claim: The passive bonus attack speed, range, on-hit magic damage, and movement speed only apply while holding an Element.
mechanics.quote: While holding an {{as|Element|buzzword}}, '''Qiyana''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on her basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and basic abilities.

mechanics.claim: The bonus movement speed only applies out of combat while moving near the held Element's source.
mechanics.quote: While [[Combat status|out-of-combat]] and moving near the {{as|Element|buzzword}} currently being held, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
